name: TheDawn

components.pose: Fast, snapping ascent: she is hurled upright out of the crater on a flash of lightning, one arm flung high, the other pulled in, hair and ribbons blasted upward, caught at the exact instant of the strike; sharp, startled-then-thrilled expression with eyes on the camera; full figure from head to toe visible.
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} coil collar with {{GEM}} stones, long spark earrings, {{METAL}} armlets
components.legs_feet: bare feet, sparks dancing around them
components.effects: Forking bolts of {{MAGIC}} lightning arc away from her across the sky and ground, shattered rock and glassy fragments falling back in slow arcs, static crackling over her skin and gown, flash-lit clouds.

notes: THE DAWN: the sister rising from the Sundering in her element's homeland - first look at her territory. Her dragon is not yet bound, so no companion; native creatures instead. Rise speed and energy differ per sister.
